audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers agree with each other (Skill, Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Skill, Renekton, Renekton) but the prose underneath them says the opposite for five rows: whys[0] 'accept the level 1 disadvantage', whys[1] 'he owns the level 2 spike harder than almost any melee matchup', whys[2] 'full kit does not solve the problem', whys[3] 'he out-pokes you', whys[5] 'outpaces your first-item timing'. The packet chart agrees with the prose, not the chart.
audit.why: Three sources, two answers: the packet levelChart and every why say Pantheon owns levels 1 through first item; the on-disk chart and the 53.64% win rate say Renekton. The packet's own defects list calls its chart contradictory, so I cannot treat it as the tiebreak either.
audit.corrected: NOT CHANGED — flagged for the user rather than guessed. Chart edits are atomic and irreversible-looking to a reader, and picking wrong here ships a level chart that inverts the lane.

audit.why: Spikes name the right four moments and are specific: Shield Vault at 2, Grand Starfall at 6 as roam pressure rather than a duel threat, his Eclipse arriving just ahead of yours, and the two-item flattening. Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1, which is why it reads as a map tool rather than a lane tool.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault was described only as 'his E grants damage reduction' with no cooldown and, more importantly, without the clause that decides how you fight it: he is 'invulnerable to damage from the front'. Renekton's own E dashes THROUGH a target, which puts you behind him.
audit.why: Riot's Pantheon E text: 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear', 22s at rank 1. Riot's Renekton E text: 'Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way'. So the counter to a raised Aegis is positional, not patience alone — and the missingInteractions file flags untargetable-dodges-burst for exactly this matchup.
audit.corrected: Say that Aegis Assault blocks only frontal damage, so dash through him and hit him from behind, and that it is 22s at rank 1 so dumping a combo into it costs you the whole window. Shield Vault's 13s rank-1 cooldown is now a number on the page.
sources: kit: Pantheon E text and cd 22/21/20/19/18

audit.whatIsWrong: A Critical Don't reads 'Sit low for his W execute'. Shield Vault is a dash that damages and stuns — there is no execute anywhere in Pantheon's kit text.
audit.why: The don't tells the player to fear a mechanic that does not exist while the real reason not to sit in front of him (Aegis Assault) went unmentioned.
audit.corrected: The body of that don't now carries the Aegis Assault cooldown and the real instruction. The title itself is 25 characters, right on the applier's skip boundary, so it is reported here rather than proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault carries an auto-attack reset, so his burst arrives on the attack wind-up rather than on the cast you see.
audit.why: Kit flag autoReset on Pantheon W plus the missingInteractions rule autoreset-burst-tell.
audit.corrected: Recorded; not written this pass because the lines that would carry it are the same ones now carrying the higher-value Aegis Assault finding.
